scope: Source interpretation ledger, not an independent source-correction certificate. Bounded means generated questions avoid the overclaim; it does not mean the source has been corrected.

issues.title: Ecosystem counts and blanket licensing/platform cards
issues.handling: Source counts and broad cards are not a current per-package census, license audit or compatibility guarantee. Questions ask only what advantages the source presents.

issues.title: Release chronology and latest wording
issues.handling: The 2017/Crystal/first-stable combination and the latest-release claim require independent chronology adjudication. No release-date answer is promoted into the pool.

issues.title: Capability versus guarantee
issues.handling: Real-time, production reliability and security cards do not establish a specific deployment’s deadlines, reliability or configured protection.

issues.title: Example platform versus universal architecture
issues.handling: Jetson centralization and suitability motivate the course example, not a universal requirement for all ROS robots.

issues.title: Node/process and isolation simplifications
issues.handling: Separate-process behavior is scoped to the pictured deployment. A surviving controller is not proof of safe behavior or automatic optimal CPU/GPU scheduling.

issues.title: Topic/type agreement is not complete interoperability proof
issues.handling: The radio analogy supplies necessary interface agreement, not a full network/discovery/QoS validation.

issues.title: Guaranteed and universally synchronous services
issues.handling: Question reasoning reconciles this wording with physical page 199 call_async; availability, request initiation and completion remain distinct.

issues.title: One server convention
issues.handling: The question bank avoids promoting one intended server into a universal enforcement theorem.

issues.title: Action transport inventory
issues.handling: The three-topics-internally phrase is not accepted as an exhaustive ROS 2 transport inventory. Goal, feedback and result semantics are taught separately; exact transport detail remains open.

issues.title: Unconditional cancellation and diagram order
issues.handling: Cancellation is a capability/request, not a guarantee after completion; box layout is not taken as mandatory chronological order.

issues.title: Runtime parameter effects
issues.handling: Questions explicitly require supported updates and active consumption of the current value. Configuration updates do not imply model retraining.

issues.title: Every frame has a parent; exact transforms at any time
issues.handling: Questions preserve the root exception and require valid frame/time data. Fixed local transforms need not change with world motion.

issues.title: Transform computation confused with mapping/simulation
issues.handling: The live 3D map label denotes frame relationships, not occupancy mapping or physical simulation. Fixed versus dynamic transform transport is not fully specified, and no complete transport inventory is asserted.

issues.title: Identical interface versus guaranteed sim-to-real transfer
issues.handling: Stable /cmd_vel supports software reuse but does not prove matching dynamics, noise, latency or friction.

issues.title: OccupancyGrid dimensionality
issues.handling: The card groups 2D or 3D maps under OccupancyGrid without disambiguating the standard interface. Dimensionality claims remain flagged and untested pending adjudication.

issues.title: Version-specific Gazebo features and direct ROS output
issues.handling: Engine/release names are not treated as a universal current support matrix. Questions retain explicit bridge/model-fidelity conditions; version-specific support remains open.
